statements.proposition: After the dependency upgrade, the project's tests pass (and the build/lint breakages from the upgrade are fixed) at the head commit.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: Installed with pnpm 9 from the PR's own pnpm-lock.yaml (frozen lockfile, --ignore-scripts) and ran jest with --no-watchman (the first run failed only because watchman is blocked by the sandbox). All tests pass; tsc --noEmit and eslint produced no output (no errors). Caveat: the PR's own GitHub Actions 'build' job concluded failure after ~7 seconds with no recorded steps (consistent with a workflow setup problem, e.g. setup-node cache: pnpm before pnpm is installed, but I did not verify the cause). That failure was not a test failure I could observe, and I ran Node v24 rather than the .nvmrc Node 22. 'All breaking changes' is interpreted as tests/build/lint, the only things checkable.
evidence: PR head 3e5d8418; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile succeeded (jest 30.1.3, ts-jest 29.4.1, typescript 5.9.2, eslint 9.x)
sbx: node_modules/.bin/jest --no-watchman -> 'Test Suites: 10 passed, 10 total; Tests: 110 passed, 110 total'
sbx: tsc --noEmit -> no output; eslint --ext .js,.jsx,.ts,.tsx ./src -> no output
gh api check-runs for head: 'build' conclusion failure, job duration ~7s, steps list empty; combined status pending
.github/workflows/ci.yml in diff uses setup-node with cache: 'pnpm' and no pnpm setup step
